name: Potential Persistence Via New AMSI Providers - Registry
description: Detects when an attacker registers a new AMSI provider in order to achieve persistence
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate security products adding their own AMSI providers. Filter these according to your environment
query: (winlog.event_data.EventType:CreateKey AND (registry.path:(*\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\AMSI\\Providers\\* OR *\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\AMSI\\Providers\\*))) AND (NOT (process.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\*)))
